joel: Back from China? You smell like fog machine.
Did the crowd jump? Mine always jumps.
I saved you the last oat milk. Don't tell Jason.
Brother! Ten thousand fans or eleven?
Next time we play together: decks and bass. Deal?
jonas: Servus! How was the Dorffest, Lederhosen-man?
Did the tuba drown you out again?
Prost! You still have hay on your hat.
The polka at 124? Easy. For me, at least.
Next time I bring the decks and you bring the band.

joel: Ha! Tell you everything after the rush.
They loved it. You'd have loved it.
Wait till you hear the next drop.
jonas: Wunderbar. The brass band says hi.
My fingers still feel the E string.

throwdownJudges.line: Three cups. Make me forget my deadline.
Show me a rosetta worthy of an aria.
Pour like it's a solo, Jason.

calm.text: Same table every day. The light's best here around three.
Roxy's reading behind the bar again. Whatever that book is, she's hooked.
She just turned a page and sighed. Must be a good chapter.
Is this the same playlist as yesterday? It's growing on me.
Whoever picks the records in here has good taste.

calm: My code compiled on the first try. I don't trust it.
I came in for one coffee. That was four hours ago.
I've been refactoring the same function since Tuesday. Every time I rename a variable the whole thing looks wrong again, so I rename it back. That's progress, right?
busy: Can't talk, the build is red.
Two more tests and I'm free. More or less.
Typing faster doesn't make it compile faster. I'm checking anyway.
Sorry, I'm in the zone. Say hi again in ten minutes?

busy.text: Deadline's at midnight. Totally fine. Totally.

stressed: It's late. Why does the bug always show up when it's late?
My mug's been empty for ages. So is my brain.
Production is down and I'm in a café. Classic.

stressed.text: I missed the deadline. They said it's fine. It doesn't feel fine.

stressed: One more coffee and I'll fix everything. Probably.
thanks: Oh, a refill! You're a lifesaver.
Exactly how I like it. Thank you!
Fresh coffee. My code thanks you too.
You read my mind. Or my empty mug.

perfect: Jason, that's a work of art. I almost don't want to drink it.
A perfect flat white. Today is a good day.
good: Nice one, Jason. Just what I needed.
Solid flat white. Back to work.
messy: A bit of a mess. So is my code, so we match.
Abstract art? I'll take it. Thanks, Jason.
